name: Diego Avina
bio:
Diego Avina, known for excelling in illustrative, realism, and watercolor styles, is a highly skilled tattoo artist based at Dark Age Tattoo Studio in DFW. His meticulous attention to detail and exceptional technical ability ensures every piece of art is a true testament to his mastery of the craft. Clients frequently commend Diego not only for the stunning tattoos he creates but also for maintaining an impeccable standard of cleanliness in his workspace, making the entire tattoo experience safe and comfortable.
